obligation.what_is_open: Construct a finite face-indexed non-even functional \(W_{p,r}\) and prove simultaneously that \(W_{p,r}(z)\le E_{p,r}(z)\) for every direction, that it dominates every relevant signed finite endpoint increment, that each active row has scale-relative covariance traction, and that the conditional lower quantile transfers uniformly, including the exact-zero-scale branch; or give a legal counterexample to such a global construction.
obligation.obstruction: The symmetric route is not merely incomplete: lem:finite-legal-probe gives a legal \(K=4\) singleton-cell law and direction \(g\) for which \(E_{p,r}(g)=0\) although the opposite ambient increment changes the endpoint, thereby refuting every dominating even functional of the form \(\max_\nu|a_\nu^{\mathsf T}z|\).  The oriented certificate fixes this parity defect only on that face.  At intersections of raw-capacity zeros, selection-total ties, and tied lower or upper cuts, a candidate positive-part face row can be canceled by simultaneous numerator and denominator derivatives outside its originating cone, so its positive part is not known to lie below \(E_{p,r}\).  Moreover, legal donor transfers alter both outcome margins, and no complete latent transfer matrix yields the row-by-row covariance traction needed when the envelope scale vanishes.  Consequently neither the global deterministic oriented comparison nor the relative non-even conditional-quantile theorem is available.
obligation.attempted: The symmetric face-probe construction and its finite-increment reduction were tested and refuted by the explicit singleton-cell certificate.  A distinct oriented construction was then checked on that same face: a survivor-to-never-selected transfer produces a nearby legal base that dominates the exact opposite-direction finite increment.  Smooth untied faces and individual selection-total boundaries were also separated conceptually, but the construction stopped at simultaneous faces because local coefficient inclusion does not survive cancellations and no covariance-traction certificate follows from face enumeration alone.  In accordance with the directive, neither failed route is asserted as a theorem.

prose_updates.tldr: The accepted parent continues to identify the causal set sharply as \(\Theta_I(p)=[L(p),U(p)]\), and the proposed common-Gaussian rectangle is a well-defined measurable statistic.  This note does not establish its uniform joint coverage over arbitrary triangular arrays.  What is proved is exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) calibration at every fixed separated regular face, uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, an explicit \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic with exact limiting coverage, a \(K=4\) counterexample to every even symmetric-probe reduction, and an oriented repair on that single counterexample face.  The all-array claim is retained only as the open legal-relative-comparison question because the global simultaneous-face oriented comparison and its scale-relative critical-value transfer remain unresolved.

prose_updates.related_work: The accepted CausalSmith survivor-complier benefit result supplies the exact sharp endpoint formula and full-law sharpness; identification is imported rather than reproved.  Angrist, Imbens, and Rubin (1996) support conditional instrument randomization, treatment consistency, and no defiers, while Dong and Heiler (2026) support treatment-mediated selection and outcome consistency together with covariate-specific weak selection monotonicity.  The fixed \(\epsilon\) overlap bound and fixed \(m_*\) aggregate denominator floor are uniform-class strengthenings here.  Fang and Santos (2019) and Hong and Li (2018) motivate derivative-aware resampling, but their generic results do not construct the required nearby legal observed laws.  Frandsen and Pond (2025), Imai and Okamoto (2026), and Andrews and Guggenberger (2009) begin from regular, asymptotically linear, or standardized representations that do not resolve the present one-sided legal-face problem at vanishing scale.  The available scale-free unsigned-Gaussian result cannot justify the needed non-even maximum.  Accordingly, the proved separated-face and diagnostic results are presented separately from the unresolved all-array question.
prose_updates.interpretation: The causal target remains the same-unit benefit probability \(\theta_B\), and the imported identification theorem gives its sharp identified set \(\Theta_I(p)=[L(p),U(p)]\).  The empirical center, directional envelope, Gaussian critical value, and rectangle are observed-law procedures; they do not define the causal target.  At separated regular faces the rectangle has exact oracle Gaussian calibration.  Uniformly over the maintained class, its fallback event is negligible and its finite coordinate widths are root-\(n\) on the complementary event.  These properties, and exact calibration on the explicit \(K=4\) diagnostic array, do not imply uniform coverage over all changing-support and tied-face arrays.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The strongest failed route is now sharply delimited.  The \(K=4\) singleton-cell witness proves that no even functional \(\max_\nu|a_\nu^{\mathsf T}z|\) lying below the legal envelope can dominate all nearby endpoint increments.  A one-sided ray and an explicit survivor-to-never-selected transfer repair parity and finite curvature on that face.  Globally, however, intersections of raw-capacity zeros, selection-total ties, and tied lower or upper cuts permit cancellations among numerator, denominator, and cut derivatives; a face row's positive part is therefore not known to be pointwise bounded by the full directional envelope.  Because the legal donor transfer changes both outcome margins, a complete row-by-row covariance-traction certificate is also absent.  Without those deterministic results, no scale-relative lower-quantile transfer or exact-zero-scale argument is available, so all-array uniform joint coverage remains open.
prose_updates.honest_scope: Sharp identification is imported from the accepted parent.  This note proves that the total procedure is measurable, proves exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) coverage only at fixed separated regular faces, proves uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, proves the stated \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic, refutes all even symmetric-probe reductions on an explicit legal \(K=4\) face, and proves an oriented repair only on that face.  It does not prove global oriented comparison, scale-relative critical-value validity, or uniform joint coverage over arbitrary triangular arrays.  No individual support, survivor-cell, cut-gap, or variance floor and no screening or deterministic guard is imposed.
